channel_description: Use Antigravity subscription models, web search, and account quota monitoring.
system_prompt_prefix_description: By default, requests from all inference clients use the native agy 1.5.11 prefix. Top-level instructions are rearranged, but standalone system and developer messages stay in the system section. With this setting off, no prefix is added, and top-level instructions stay in the system section in their original order. HTTP 429 errors can still occur with the prefix.
authorization_description: Sign in through Google, then paste the code displayed by the Antigravity callback page. Third-party OAuth access may violate Google's terms and lead to account suspension.
